The path may be real, but neither Grokbot nor this audit could confirm that it shows Barnet's current local validation list.

issues.detail: Grokbot gives no list date. Barnet has recently consulted on proposed changes to its local list of validation requirements (engage page last updated 06 Oct 2025, outcome not published). A revised list may already be in force, so the list's date and currency need checking manually in a browser. Older Barnet local-requirements PDFs (e.g. 'Nationallocalrequirementsmay12.pdf', May 2012) are still indexed and must not be used.

summary: Barnet's site blocks automated fetching, so neither Grokbot nor this audit could read the local list. Grokbot holds no requirements and no date, and its unverified third-party URL could not be confirmed. A 2025 consultation on revising Barnet's local list means the current version needs a manual browser check.
